tools.name: coldread_check
tools.description: Before paying an x402 seller: one signed, independent report combining a 402-challenge lint, signed-offer and signer-authorization checks, an ERC-8004 identity lookup and a labelled Base USDC payer summary over the last ~28 h. Read-only; never pays. Free.

tools.name: coldread_get_report
tools.description: Fetch a stored signed report by its sha256 digest (reports are kept 90 days).

tools.name: coldread_verify_report
tools.description: Check that a ColdRead report envelope is unmodified (JCS + sha256) and signed by a published ColdRead key. Pass the whole envelope {report, digest, signature}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "coldread_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
